status: bounded maintainer technical decision; independent review required
scope: Initial first-tabbable focus readiness in browser applications with supplied document, application reference and render injector; not general event or focus parity
decision: For stable NgZone when real application and injector are present, retain the two render callback readiness sequence before completing pending afterOpened. When a qualifying browser application begins initial first-tabbable focus in an unstable NgZone, afterOpened waits until the existing onStable focus attempt and any empty fallback settle; close or destroy cancels pending work. Stable manual construction and nonbrowser/no-document paths retain direct historical behavior. Other autofocus modes and normal recapture are not authorized for a broad timing change.
rationale: Actual tagged16 stable first-tabbable focus can occur before open returns; delayFocusTrap true emits afterOpened before later focus. Retained design accommodates the tested initial NgModel update. A later asynchronous model change is not guaranteed to settle. Attempts to restore stable timing globally caused a transient wrong-radio focus; public-only mode classifiers failed nested zones or added observable NgZone lifecycle events. No such classifier is adopted.
closed_shadow: An internal focus change within the same closed shadow host before afterOpened may be unobservable to document focus listeners and can be overwritten. Canonical clean 668 actual native traces show this in four modes. Tagged16 delay=false retained the comparable early choice; delay=true later overwrote it. Make closed-shadow focus choices after afterOpened. With the proposed fix, these afterOpened choices are preserved in four bounded native modes, including empty fallback.

results: Four native zoneful, zoneless, zoneless-in-foreign-NgZone and injected public NgZone subclass runs retain raw nonzero status because early closed-shadow choice is overwritten; remaining enumerated assertions and exact-once guard pass. Native gap and empty-fallback cases pass zoneful and zoneless; post-open recapture succeeds in all four. No subsequent user interaction was used to cause delayed-open completion. Focus source 48 cases/17 mutants and motion 20/6; actual native enabled-motion race is zoneless only. Per-open policy parent/view injector/explicit override checks and backdrop classes pass in both modes.
limits: Pre-afterOpened same-closed-root focus is unsupported; no private introspection, event fabrication or mode classifier.
Focus cleanup gap source test uses a public-trap wrapper to schedule an observable open-shadow choice; closed shadow remains unobservable.

When pending initial focus is replaced by empty-dialog backdrop recapture, opened waits for the replacement fallback to settle; close or destroy cancels it. Baseline packed v3 opened with focus still outside.

Open-shadow recapture checks walk visible active hosts and retain the selected in-dialog element; the packed v2 regression shows the previous late steal. Closed shadow descendants remain unobservable beyond their host.
No guarantee for arbitrary later asynchronous state.
Chrome149 only; no full historical family suite, release, G01-G13, browser matrix, security or G11 pass.
Original runner source and temp npm/bundle paths are recorded snapshots, not portable standalone replay assets.
Tag differential uses JIT; candidate browser fixtures use packed Angular AOT.
Exact pending author-use reviews must be requalified for source changes; this capsule does not update ledger.
The no-document eligibility controls execute the actual source class with a synthetic injected document in a source harness; they are not a native packed null-document application test.
